days.title: Summit Peaks and Volcanic Fissures
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Goðasteinn
stops.detail: Other well-known peaks are Goðasteinn in the north of the main crater and Hámundur in the south of the main crater.

stops.name: Skerin Ridge
stops.detail: Skerin Ridge is a radial eruption fissure found in the northwest of the Eyjafjallajökull summit caldera.

stops.name: Gígjökull
stops.detail: The most significant of these outlet glaciers are Steinholtsjökull and Gígjökull, which extend northwards in the direction of the Markarfljót river.

stops.name: Eyjarhellir
stops.detail: A whole series of geographical proper names in this area are compounds with ey (German "island"), e.g., Petursey, Akurey, Hallgeirsey, Thorvaldsey, Eyjarmýri ("island moor"), Eyjarhellir ("island cave") and also Eyjarfjöll ("island mountains") and Eyjafjallajökull ("island mountain glacier").
